subject: Next steps: VoiceCraft pilot — model shortlist & perf snapshots
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava@voicecraft.ai>, Luke Hargreaves <luke.h@voicecraft.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: VoiceCraft pilot — model shortlist & perf snapshots

Hi Ava / Luke,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good convo on latency targets and the batch/real-time mix for the voice assistant. I promised a concise follow-up with model recommendations plus Redwood-verified performance snapshots to help you pick a pilot path. High level first, then links/attachments.

Quick summary of our read:
- Priority constraints: 200–512 token responses, p95 latency target <= 300ms in our hosted environment, burst TPS up to ~45 req/s during morning peaks.
- Quality requirement: conversational coherence + short factual lookups; hallucination risk must be low for system prompts.

Shortlist (recommended for a 6-week pilot):
1) rl-3b-quant-v2 (8-bit quant profile) — best latency/cost balance for 200–512 tokens; recommended for MVP NLU + response generation.
2) gpt-lite-7b-fp16 — higher quality for multi-turn; expect higher tail latency but superior coherence on follow-ups.
3) rerank-1.1 (cpu) — lightweight reranker for on-device ranking to reduce API traffic.

Attached: redwood_verified_perf_profiles.csv (per-model TPS & latency percentiles at common payloads), latency-percentiles-512tokens.png (p50/p95/p99 snapshots), pilot_scope_v1.docx (draft scope & success criteria).

Immediate asks / proposed next steps:
- You confirm the pilot scope (MVP intents + peak load estimate) — if ok we’ll provision a reserved pilot pool.
- We’ll run a short 48-hour A/B perf sweep for rl-3b-quant-v2 vs gpt-lite-7b to capture latency tail under your sample prompts.
- Marissa will drop exact perf numbers and quantization tradeoffs (cc’d).
- If procurement needs an estimate, I can share a rough committed spend range for a 6-week pilot.

Links: https://redwood.ai/perf-profiles/voicecraft-shortlist (pilot pack), HubSpot: VC-1198.

Thanks — I’ll stand by for a confirmation on scope so we can schedule the sweep.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Ava — quick perf + residency notes below and a concrete pilot proposal.

Perf snapshots (hosted Redwood Dedicated pool, single-region US-West, 1 GPU worker per shard):
- rl-3b-quant-v2 (8-bit): p50=48ms, p95=210ms, p99=340ms for 512-token requests (streaming disabled). TPS steady-state ~60 req/s per shard (batching/windowing enabled).
- gpt-lite-7b-fp16: p50=85ms, p95=420ms, p99=780ms for 512 tokens. TPS steady-state ~22 req/s per shard.
- Notes: enabling streaming reduces p95 by ~70–90ms on average for both models for end-user perceived latency. The CSV attached has multiple sequence-length breakouts and sample prompt sets used.

Quant & pipelines:
- The 8-bit quant profile is production-ready in Redwood's runtime; compatibility with downstream safety/post-processing is a function of your integration. We run byte-for-byte same output semantics for model logits, but small distributional deltas can occur — we recommend running your safety filters on a 48-hour test traffic replay.

Data residency / pilot pools:
- We can provision a US-only hosted pilot pool (control plane in Redwood, compute in US-West) and provide audit logs for requests. If you need tenant-segregated logs or longer audit retention for compliance, we can add that as an enterprise add-on (timeline: ~2 business days to enable).

Proposed pilot plan (6 weeks):
- Week 0: provisioning & sample prompt collection + 48-hr A/B sweep (rl-3b-quant-v2 vs gpt-lite-7b).
- Week 1–4: pilot traffic with telemetry (quality, latency p50/p95/p99, cost).
- Week 5: internal eval & regression checks against prompt sets; quality gates pass/fail.
- Week 6: handover recommendations and next-step commercial proposal.

Attachments: redwood_verified_perf_profiles.csv (detailed numbers), pilot_scope_v1.docx (editable scope).

If this looks good I’ll create the short MOP + test plan and share it in Drive. Sean — if procurement numbers would help for Monday, I can draft a committed spend range for a pilot pool and expected overage profile.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
